import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static int bitCount(int n) {
        int count = 0;
        while (n != 0) {
            count += n & 1;
            n >>>= 1;
        }
        return count;
    }

    static long modExp(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static class HallChecker {
        List<int[]> dp;
        List<Integer> maxMatch;
        int stateCount;
        int sizeN;

        HallChecker(int n) {
            sizeN = n;
            stateCount = 0;
            dp = new ArrayList<>();
            maxMatch = new ArrayList<>();
            int N = 1 << n;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                dp.add(new int[0]);
                maxMatch.add(-1);
            }
        }

        int addState(boolean[] state) {
            int id = findState(state);
            if (id == -1) {
                id = stateCount++;
                dp.add(new int[state.length]);
                for (int i = 0; i < state.length; i++) {
                    dp.get(id)[i] = state[i] ? 1 : 0;
                }
                maxMatch.add(-1);
            }
            return id;
        }

        private int findState(boolean[] state) {
            for (int i = 0; i < stateCount; i++) {
                boolean eq = true;
                for (int j = 0; j < state.length && eq; j++) {
                    eq = (dp.get(i)[j] == (state[j] ? 1 : 0));
                }
                if (eq) return i;
            }
            return -1;
        }
    }

    static void preCalc(int n, HallChecker hc) {
        int N = 1 << n;
        boolean[][] fixedSize = new boolean[n + 1][N];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                fixedSize[i][mask] = false;
            }
        }
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
            int bits = bitCount(mask);
            fixedSize[bits][mask] = true;
        }
        
        List<boolean[]> states = new ArrayList<>();
        boolean[] initialState = new boolean[N];
        initialState[0] = true;
        states.add(initialState);
        
        List<int[]> nextTrans = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            nextTrans.add(new int[N]);
        }
        
        for (int k = 0; k < states.size(); k++) {
            boolean[][] predHall = new boolean[n][N];
            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                if (states.get(k)[mask]) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        predHall[i][mask | (1 << i)] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                boolean[] nextState = states.get(k).clone();
                
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                            if (predHall[i][j]) {
                                nextState[j] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                int[] nextTransRow = nextTrans.get(k);
                nextTransRow[mask] = hc.addState(nextState);
            }
            
            for (int i = n; i >= 0; i--) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    if (states.get(k)[j] && fixedSize[i][j]) {
                        hc.maxMatch.set(k, i);
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (hc.maxMatch.get(k) != -1) break;
            }
        }
        
        hc.nextTrans = nextTrans;
    }

    static class HallCheckerWithNextTrans extends HallChecker {
        List<int[]> nextTrans;

        HallCheckerWithNextTrans(int n) {
            super(n);
            nextTrans = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = n;

        HallCheckerWithNextTrans hc = new HallCheckerWithNextTrans(n);
        preCalc(n, hc);

        long[][] prob = new long[n][m];
        long inv100 = modExp(100, MOD - 2, MOD);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                long x = scanner.nextLong();
                prob[i][j] = (x * inv100) % MOD;
            }
        }

        int N = 1 << n;
        long[] prevState = new long[hc.stateCount];
        long[] curState = new long[hc.stateCount];
        prevState[0] = 1;

        for (int col = 0; col < m; col++) {
            Arrays.fill(curState, 0);
            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                long pMask = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                        pMask = (pMask * prob[i][col]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        pMask = (pMask * (MOD - prob[i][col])) % MOD;
                    }
                }
                
                for (int k = 0; k < hc.stateCount; k++) {
                    if (prevState[k] == 0) continue;
                    int nextIdx = hc.nextTrans.get(k)[mask];
                    curState[nextIdx] = (curState[nextIdx] + pMask * prevState[k]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            System.arraycopy(curState, 0, prevState, 0, hc.stateCount);
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < hc.stateCount; k++) {
            if (hc.maxMatch.get(k) == n) {
                ans = (ans + prevState[k]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        ans = (ans % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
